run_preprocess_iwslt17: run the CLI to preprocess IWSLT17 fr-en bitext with BPE, BBPE, byte, or char vocab options
run_pretokenize: run Moses pretokenization on a text file for a given source and target language pair
run_get_bpe: run SentencePiece BPE training on a concatenated training file with a specified vocabulary size
run_apply_bbpe: run byte-level BPE tokenization on a text file using a trained SentencePiece model
run_apply_bpe: run standard BPE tokenization on a text file using a trained SentencePiece model
